video.title: New Orleans Pelicans Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

summary: Josh Lloyd previews the 2026-27 New Orleans Pelicans for fantasy. He calls the roster crowded and badly built: as many as 10 players could get drafted, but there is not enough usage or minutes to go around under new coach Jamahl Mosley. His best target is Dejounte Murray, who should beat his ranks if he gets 33 minutes. His main fade is Trey Murphy III at his Yahoo rank of 28, especially in points leagues. He is down on Zion Williamson because his usage dropped, and he sees Herb Jones as steals only. He likes Jeremiah Fears and Derik Queen as late swings, and Queen is the best stash if Zion gets hurt or traded. The schedule is good for leagues ending March 28 but has a two-game week in the second-to-last week, and the team has a league-high 16 back-to-backs.
